customManagers.description: actionlint is installed with `go install` in ci.yml, where no built-in manager can see its version

packageRules.description: postgres majors are a deliberate choice, never an update — GlitchTip's DB compatibility is pinned to its app version (compose.glitchtip.yml:150) and the demo pins its own major (compose.demo.yml:72). Both tags are intentionally left floating within their series, so every update Renovate could offer here is one that must not happen automatically.

GlitchTip re-pins are deliberate: glitchtip-migrate runs irreversible Django migrations on every `up`, so a bump needs `make backup` first (compose.glitchtip.yml:82-83). Surface the drift on the dependency dashboard instead of opening a mergeable PR.
Majors never join a group and never automerge
